versos.hebraico: לְמוֹאָ֡ב כֹּֽה־אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל ה֤וֹי אֶל־נְבוֹ֙ כִּ֣י שֻׁדָּ֔דָה הֹבִ֥ישָׁה נִלְכְּדָ֖ה קִרְיָתָ֑יִם הֹבִ֥ישָׁה הַמִּשְׂגָּ֖ב וָחָֽתָּה׃

controles.web: Of Moab. Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Woe to Nebo! for it is laid waste; Kiriathaim is disappointed, it is taken; Misgab is put to shame and broken down.
controles.kjv: Against Moab thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.
controles.livre: Sobre Moabe.Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Ai de Nebo! Pois foi arruinada; envergonhada está Quiriataim, já foi tomada; Misgabe está envergonhada e espantada.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣ין עוֹד֮ תְּהִלַּ֣ת מוֹאָב֒ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן חָשְׁב֤וּ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ רָעָ֔ה לְכ֖וּ וְנַכְרִיתֶ֣נָּה מִגּ֑וֹי גַּם־מַדְמֵ֣ן תִּדֹּ֔מִּי אַחֲרַ֖יִךְ תֵּ֥לֶךְ חָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: The praise of Moab is no more; in Heshbon they have devised evil against her: Come, and let us cut her off from being a nation. You also, Madmen, shall be brought to silence: the sword shall pursue you.
controles.kjv: There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.
controles.livre: Já não há mais exaltação em Moabe; em Hesbom tramaram o mal contra ela, dizendo : Vinde, e a eliminemos das nações. Também tu, Madmém, serás cortada fora; a espada irá atrás de ti.

versos.hebraico: ק֥וֹל צְעָקָ֖ה מֵחֹֽרוֹנָ֑יִם שֹׁ֖ד וָשֶׁ֥בֶר גָּדֽוֹל׃

controles.web: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!
controles.kjv: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.
controles.livre: Ouve-se uma voz de clamor de Horonaim: Ruína e grande destruição!

versos.hebraico: נִשְׁבְּרָ֖ה מוֹאָ֑ב הִשְׁמִ֥יעוּ זְּעָקָ֖ה צעוריה׃

controles.web: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
controles.kjv: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
controles.livre: Moabe foi destruída; fizeram com que se ouvisse o grito de seus pequenos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֚י מַעֲלֵ֣ה הלחות בִּבְכִ֖י יַֽעֲלֶה־בֶּ֑כִי כִּ֚י בְּמוֹרַ֣ד חוֹרֹנַ֔יִם צָרֵ֥י צַֽעֲקַת־שֶׁ֖בֶר שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃

controles.web: For by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping shall they go up; for at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.
controles.kjv: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.
controles.livre: Pois na subida de Luíte subirão com grande choro; pois na descida de Horonaim os inimigos de Moabe ouviram clamor de destruição.

versos.hebraico: נֻ֖סוּ מַלְּט֣וּ נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וְתִֽהְיֶ֕ינָה כַּעֲרוֹעֵ֖ר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

controles.web: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
controles.kjv: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
controles.livre: Fugi, livrai vossa vida, e sereis como um arbusto  no deserto.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֠י יַ֣עַן בִּטְחֵ֤ךְ בְּמַעֲשַׂ֨יִךְ֙ וּבְא֣וֹצְרוֹתַ֔יִךְ גַּם־אַ֖תְּ תִּלָּכֵ֑דִי וְיָצָ֤א כמיש בַּגּוֹלָ֔ה כֹּהֲנָ֥יו וְשָׂרָ֖יו יחד׃

controles.web: For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also shall be taken: and Chemosh shall go out into captivity, his priests and his princes together.
controles.kjv: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together.
controles.livre: Pois por causa de tua confiança confiaste em tuas obras e em teus tesouros, tu também serás tomada; e Quemos irá ao cativeiro, seus sacerdotes e juntamente seus príncipes.

versos.hebraico: וְיָבֹ֨א שֹׁדֵ֜ד אֶל־כָּל־עִ֗יר וְעִיר֙ לֹ֣א תִמָּלֵ֔ט וְאָבַ֥ד הָעֵ֖מֶק וְנִשְׁמַ֣ד הַמִּישֹׁ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: The destroyer shall come on every city, and no city shall escape; the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed; as Yahweh has spoken.
controles.kjv: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the Lord hath spoken.
controles.livre: Pois virá o destruidor a cada uma das cidades, e nenhuma cidade escapará; e perecerá também o vale, e será destruída a planície,pois assim diz o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: תְּנוּ־צִ֣יץ לְמוֹאָ֔ב כִּ֥י נָצֹ֖א תֵּצֵ֑א וְעָרֶ֨יהָ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ינָה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּהֵֽן׃

controles.web: Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get her away: and her cities shall become a desolation, without any to dwell therein.
controles.kjv: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.
controles.livre: Dai asas a Moabe, para que ele saia voando; pois suas cidades se tornarão desertas até não restar quem more nelas.

versos.hebraico: אָר֗וּר עֹשֶׂ֛ה מְלֶ֥אכֶת יְהוָ֖ה רְמִיָּ֑ה וְאָר֕וּר מֹנֵ֥עַ חַרְבּ֖וֹ מִדָּֽם׃

controles.web: Cursed is he who does the work of Yahweh negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.
controles.kjv: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the Lord deceitfully, and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.
controles.livre: Maldito aquele que fizer enganosamente  a obra do SENHOR, e maldito aquele que detiver sua espada do sangue.

versos.hebraico: שַׁאֲנַ֨ן מוֹאָ֜ב מִנְּעוּרָ֗יו וְשֹׁקֵ֥ט הוּא֙ אֶל־שְׁמָרָ֔יו וְלֹֽא־הוּרַ֤ק מִכְּלִי֙ אֶל־כֶּ֔לִי וּבַגּוֹלָ֖ה לֹ֣א הָלָ֑ךְ עַל־כֵּ֗ן עָמַ֤ד טַעְמוֹ֙ בּ֔וֹ וְרֵיח֖וֹ לֹ֥א נָמָֽר׃ס

controles.web: Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his lees, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.
controles.kjv: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.
controles.livre: Tranquilo esteve Moabe desde sua juventude, e sobre suas impurezas  esteve quieto; e não foi esvaziado de vaso em vaso, nem nunca foi ao cativeiro; por isso seu sabor ficou nele, e seu cheiro não mudou.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֞ן הִנֵּ֖ה־יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־ל֥וֹ צֹעִ֖ים וְצֵעֻ֑הוּ וְכֵלָ֣יו יָרִ֔יקוּ וְנִבְלֵיהֶ֖ם יְנַפֵּֽצוּ׃

controles.web: Therefore behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will send to him those who pour off, and they shall pour him off; and they shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles in pieces.
controles.kjv: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.
controles.livre: Por isso eis que vêm dias, diz o SENHOR, em que eu lhe enviarei derramadores que o derramarão; e esvaziarão seus vasos, e romperão seus jarros.

versos.hebraico: וּבֹ֥שׁ מוֹאָ֖ב מִכְּמ֑וֹשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר־בֹּ֨שׁוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִבֵּ֥ית אֵ֖ל מִבְטֶחָֽם׃

controles.web: Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.
controles.kjv: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Beth–el their confidence.
controles.livre: E Moabe se envergonhará de Quemos, assim como a casa de Israel se envergonhou de Betel, que era sua confiança.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֚יךְ תֹּֽאמְר֔וּ גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים אֲנָ֑חְנוּ וְאַנְשֵׁי־חַ֖יִל לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

controles.web: How do you say, We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war?
controles.kjv: How say ye, We are mighty and strong men for the war?
controles.livre: Como direis: Somos guerreiros, homens valentes para a guerra?

versos.hebraico: שֻׁדַּ֤ד מוֹאָב֙ וְעָרֶ֣יהָ עָלָ֔ה וּמִבְחַ֥ר בַּֽחוּרָ֖יו יָרְד֣וּ לַטָּ֑בַח נְאֻ֨ם־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Moab is laid waste, and they are gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies.
controles.kjv: Moab is spoiled, and gone up out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts.
controles.livre: Moabe é destruído, e suas cidades invadidas, e seus melhores rapazes descem ao degoladouro, diz o rei, cujo nome é EU-SOU dos exércitos.

versos.hebraico: קָר֥וֹב אֵיד־מוֹאָ֖ב לָב֑וֹא וְרָ֣עָת֔וֹ מִהֲרָ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃

controles.web: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hurries fast.
controles.kjv: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.
controles.livre: Próxima está a vinda da perdição de Moabe; e seu desastre  vem com muita pressa.

versos.hebraico: נֻ֤דוּ לוֹ֙ כָּל־סְבִיבָ֔יו וְכֹ֖ל יֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ אִמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֤ה נִשְׁבַּר֙ מַטֵּה־עֹ֔ז מַקֵּ֖ל תִּפְאָרָֽה׃

controles.web: All you who are around him, bemoan him, and all you who know his name; say, How is the strong staff broken, the beautiful rod!
controles.kjv: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!
controles.livre: Condoei-vos dele todos vós que estais ao seu redor, e todos vós que sabeis seu nome. Dizei: Como se quebrou a vara forte, o belo cajado!

versos.hebraico: רְדִ֤י מִכָּבוֹד֙ ישבי בַצָּמָ֔א יֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בַּת־דִּיב֑וֹן כִּֽי־שֹׁדֵ֤ד מוֹאָב֙ עָ֣לָה בָ֔ךְ שִׁחֵ֖ת מִבְצָרָֽיִךְ׃

controles.web: You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you, he has destroyed your strongholds.
controles.kjv: Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from thy glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee, and he shall destroy thy strong holds.
controles.livre: Desce da tua glória, e senta-te no lugar seco, ó moradora, filha de Dibom; pois o destruidor de Moabe subiu contra ti, e arruinou tuas fortalezas.

versos.hebraico: אֶל־דֶּ֛רֶךְ עִמְדִ֥י וְצַפִּ֖י יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת עֲרוֹעֵ֑ר שַׁאֲלִי־נָ֣ס וְנִמְלָ֔טָה אִמְרִ֖י מַה־נִּֽהְיָֽתָה׃

controles.web: Inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and watch: ask him who flees, and her who escapes; say, What has been done?
controles.kjv: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth, and say, What is done?
controles.livre: Para-te no caminho, e olha, ó moradora de Aroer; pergunta ao que vai fugindo, e à que escapou, dize: O que aconteceu?

versos.hebraico: הֹבִ֥ישׁ מוֹאָ֛ב כִּֽי־חַ֖תָּה הילילי׀ וזעקי הַגִּ֣ידוּ בְאַרְנ֔וֹן כִּ֥י שֻׁדַּ֖ד מוֹאָֽב׃

controles.web: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down: wail and cry; tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.
controles.kjv: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,
controles.livre: Responderão : Moabe está envergonhado, porque foi quebrantado; uivai e gritai; anunciai em Arnom que Moabe foi destruído,

versos.hebraico: וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט בָּ֖א אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ הַמִּישֹׁ֑ר אֶל־חֹל֥וֹן וְאֶל־יַ֖הְצָה וְעַל־מופעת׃

controles.web: Judgment has come on the plain country, on Holon, and on Jahzah, and on Mephaath,
controles.kjv: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,
controles.livre: O julgamento também veio juízo sobre a terra da planície: sobre Holom, sobre Jazá, e sobre Mefate;

versos.hebraico: וְעַל־דִּיב֣וֹן וְעַל־נְב֔וֹ וְעַל־בֵּ֖ית דִּבְלָתָֽיִם׃

controles.web: and on Dibon, and on Nebo, and on Beth Diblathaim,
controles.kjv: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth–diblathaim,
controles.livre: Sobre Dibom, sobre Nebo, e sobre Bete-Diblataim;

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֧ל קִרְיָתַ֛יִם וְעַל־בֵּ֥ית גָּמ֖וּל וְעַל־בֵּ֥ית מְעֽוֹן׃

controles.web: and on Kiriathaim, and on Beth Gamul, and on Beth Meon,
controles.kjv: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth–gamul, and upon Beth–meon,
controles.livre: Sobre Quiriataim, sobre Bete-Gamul, e sobre Bete-Meom;

versos.hebraico: וְעַל־קְרִיּ֖וֹת וְעַל־בָּצְרָ֑ה וְעַ֗ל כָּל־עָרֵי֙ אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב הָרְחֹק֖וֹת וְהַקְּרֹבֽוֹת׃

controles.web: and on Kerioth, and on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
controles.kjv: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
controles.livre: Sobre Queriote, sobre Bosra, e sobre todas as cidades da terra de Moabe, as de longe e as de perto.

versos.hebraico: נִגְדְּעָה֙ קֶ֣רֶן מוֹאָ֔ב וּזְרֹע֖וֹ נִשְׁבָּ֑רָה נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, says Yahweh.
controles.kjv: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith the Lord.
controles.livre: O poder de Moabe foi cortado, e seu braço quebrado,diz o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: הַשְׁכִּירֻ֕הוּ כִּ֥י עַל־יְהוָ֖ה הִגְדִּ֑יל וְסָפַ֤ק מוֹאָב֙ בְּקִיא֔וֹ וְהָיָ֥ה לִשְׂחֹ֖ק גַּם־הֽוּא׃

controles.web: Make him drunken; for he magnified himself against Yahweh: and Moab shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
controles.kjv: Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the Lord: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
controles.livre: Embriagai-o, pois contra o SENHOR se engrandeceu; e Moabe se revolverá sobre seu vômito, e ele também será por escárnio.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֣ם׀ ל֣וֹא הַשְּׂחֹ֗ק הָיָ֤ה לְךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִם־בְּגַנָּבִ֖ים נמצאה כִּֽי־מִדֵּ֧י דְבָרֶ֥יךָ בּ֖וֹ תִּתְנוֹדָֽד׃

controles.web: For wasn’t Israel a derision to you? was he found among thieves? for as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.
controles.kjv: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.
controles.livre: Pois para ti não foi Israel por escárnio? Por acaso ele foi achado entre ladrões, para que balances a cabeça quando falas dele?

versos.hebraico: עִזְב֤וּ עָרִים֙ וְשִׁכְנ֣וּ בַּסֶּ֔לַע יֹשְׁבֵ֖י מוֹאָ֑ב וִֽהְי֣וּ כְיוֹנָ֔ה תְּקַנֵּ֖ן בְּעֶבְרֵ֥י פִי־פָֽחַת׃

controles.web: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock; and be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss.
controles.kjv: O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove that maketh her nest in the sides of the hole’s mouth.
controles.livre: Deixai as cidades, e habitai em rochedos, ó moradores de Moabe; e sejais como a pomba que faz ninho nas brechas da boca da caverna.

versos.hebraico: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ גְאוֹן־מוֹאָ֖ב גֵּאֶ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד גָּבְה֧וֹ וּגְאוֹנ֛וֹ וְגַאֲוָת֖וֹ וְרֻ֥ם לִבּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud; his loftiness, and his pride, and his arrogance, and the haughtiness of his heart.
controles.kjv: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.
controles.livre: Temos ouvido a soberba de Moabe, que é soberbo demais, assim como sua arrogância e seu orgulho, sua altivez e a altura de seu coração.

versos.hebraico: אֲנִ֤י יָדַ֨עְתִּי֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה עֶבְרָת֖וֹ וְלֹא־כֵ֑ן בַּדָּ֖יו לֹא־כֵ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃

controles.web: I know his wrath, says Yahweh, that it is nothing; his boastings have worked nothing.
controles.kjv: I know his wrath, saith the Lord; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it.
controles.livre: Eu conheço sua insolência,diz o SENHOR; porém não será assim; suas mentiras lhe serão em vão.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כֵּן֙ עַל־מוֹאָ֣ב אֲיֵלִ֔יל וּלְמוֹאָ֥ב כֻּלֹּ֖ה אֶזְעָ֑ק אֶל־אַנְשֵׁ֥י קִֽיר־חֶ֖רֶשׂ יֶהְגֶּֽה׃

controles.web: Therefore will I wail for Moab; yes, I will cry out for all Moab: for the men of Kir Heres shall they mourn.
controles.kjv: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; mine heart shall mourn for the men of Kir–heres.
controles.livre: Por isso eu uivarei por Moabe, e gritarei por todo Moabe; gemerão por causa dos homens de Quir-Heres.

versos.hebraico: מִבְּכִ֨י יַעְזֵ֤ר אֶבְכֶּה־לָּךְ֙ הַגֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֔ה נְטִֽישֹׁתַ֨יִךְ֙ עָ֣בְרוּ יָ֔ם עַ֛ד יָ֥ם יַעְזֵ֖ר נָגָ֑עוּ עַל־קֵיצֵ֥ךְ וְעַל־בְּצִירֵ֖ךְ שֹׁדֵ֥ד נָפָֽל׃

controles.web: With more than the weeping of Jazer will I weep for you, vine of Sibmah: your branches passed over the sea, they reached even to the sea of Jazer: on your summer fruits and on your vintage the destroyer is fallen.
controles.kjv: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.
controles.livre: Com o choro de Jazer chorarei por ti, ó vide de Sibma; teus sarmentos passaram o mar, e chegaram até o mar de Jazer; porém o destruidor veio sobre os frutos de teu verão, e sobre tua vindima.

versos.hebraico: וְנֶאֶסְפָ֨ה שִׂמְחָ֥ה וָגִ֛יל מִכַּרְמֶ֖ל וּמֵאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֑ב וְיַ֨יִן֙ מִיקָבִ֣ים הִשְׁבַּ֔תִּי לֹֽא־יִדְרֹ֣ךְ הֵידָ֔ד הֵידָ֖ד לֹ֥א הֵידָֽד׃

controles.web: Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to cease from the wine presses: no one shall tread with shouting; the shouting shall be no shouting.
controles.kjv: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.
controles.livre: Assim foram tirados a alegria e o regozijo dos campos férteis, e da terra de Moabe: pois fiz cessar o vinho dos lagares; já não pisarão uvas com júbilo; o grito não será de júbilo.

versos.hebraico: מִזַּעֲקַ֨ת חֶשְׁבּ֜וֹן עַד־אֶלְעָלֵ֗ה עַד־יַ֨הַץ֙ נָתְנ֣וּ קוֹלָ֔ם מִצֹּ֨עַר֙ עַד־חֹ֣רֹנַ֔יִם עֶגְלַ֖ת שְׁלִֽשִׁיָּ֑ה כִּ֚י גַּם־מֵ֣י נִמְרִ֔ים לִמְשַׁמּ֖וֹת יִהְיֽוּ׃

controles.web: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to Eglath Shelishiyah: for the waters of Nimrim also shall become desolate.
controles.kjv: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, and even unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.
controles.livre: Houve um grito desde Hesbom até Eleale e até Jaaz; deram sua voz desde Zoar até Horonaim e Eglate-Selísia; pois também as águas de Ninrim serão assoladas.

versos.hebraico: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י לְמוֹאָ֖ב נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה מַעֲלֶ֣ה בָמָ֔ה וּמַקְטִ֖יר לֵאלֹהָֽיו׃

controles.web: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, says Yahweh, him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods.
controles.kjv: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the Lord, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.
controles.livre: E eu,diz o SENHOR, farei cessar de Moabe quem sacrifique no lugar alto, e quem ofereça incenso a seus deuses.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כֵּ֞ן לִבִּ֤י לְמוֹאָב֙ כַּחֲלִלִ֣ים יֶהֱמֶ֔ה וְלִבִּי֙ אֶל־אַנְשֵׁ֣י קִֽיר־חֶ֔רֶשׂ כַּחֲלִילִ֖ים יֶהֱמֶ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֛ן יִתְרַ֥ת עָשָׂ֖ה אָבָֽדוּ׃

controles.web: Therefore my heart sounds for Moab like pipes, and my heart sounds like pipes for the men of Kir Heres: therefore the abundance that he has gotten is perished.
controles.kjv: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir–heres: because the riches that he hath gotten are perished.
controles.livre: Portanto meu coração ressoará como flautas por causa de Moab; também meu coração ressoará como flautas pelos homens de Quir-Heres; pois as riquezas que tinham acumulado se perderam;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י כָל־רֹאשׁ֙ קָרְחָ֔ה וְכָל־זָקָ֖ן גְּרֻעָ֑ה עַ֤ל כָּל־יָדַ֨יִם֙ גְּדֻדֹ֔ת וְעַל־מָתְנַ֖יִם שָֽׂק׃

controles.web: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped: on all the hands are cuttings, and on the waist sackcloth.
controles.kjv: For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.
controles.livre: Pois em toda cabeça haverá calva, e toda barba será cortada; sobre todas mãos há arranhões, e sobre todos os lombos há sacos.

versos.hebraico: עַ֣ל כָּל־גַּגּ֥וֹת מוֹאָ֛ב וּבִרְחֹבֹתֶ֖יהָ כֻּלֹּ֣ה מִסְפֵּ֑ד כִּֽי־שָׁבַ֣רְתִּי אֶת־מוֹאָ֗ב כִּכְלִ֛י אֵֽין־חֵ֥פֶץ בּ֖וֹ נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: On all the housetops of Moab and in its streets there is lamentation every where; for I have broken Moab like a vessel in which no one delights, says Yahweh.
controles.kjv: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith the Lord.
controles.livre: Sobre todas os terraços de Moabe e em suas ruas, em todo ele haverá pranto; pois eu quebrantei a Moabe como a um vaso desagradável,diz o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֥יךְ חַ֨תָּה֙ הֵילִ֔ילוּ אֵ֛יךְ הִפְנָה־עֹ֥רֶף מוֹאָ֖ב בּ֑וֹשׁ וְהָיָ֥ה מוֹאָ֛ב לִשְׂחֹ֥ק וְלִמְחִתָּ֖ה לְכָל־סְבִיבָֽיו׃ס

controles.web: How it is broken down! How they wail! How Moab has turned the back with shame! So shall Moab become a derision and a terror to all who are around him.
controles.kjv: They shall howl, saying, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.
controles.livre: Como foi quebrantado! Como uivam! Como Moabe virou as costas, e se envergonhou! Assim Moabe servirá de escárnio e de espanto a todos os que estão ao seu redor.

versos.hebraico: כִּי־כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֥ה כַנֶּ֖שֶׁר יִדְאֶ֑ה וּפָרַ֥שׂ כְּנָפָ֖יו אֶל־מוֹאָֽב׃

controles.web: For thus says Yahweh: Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread out his wings against Moab.
controles.kjv: For thus saith the Lord; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.
controles.livre: Pois assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que voará como águia, e estenderá suas asas sobre Moabe.

versos.hebraico: נִלְכְּדָה֙ הַקְּרִיּ֔וֹת וְהַמְּצָד֖וֹת נִתְפָּ֑שָׂה וְֽ֠הָיָה לֵ֞ב גִּבּוֹרֵ֤י מוֹאָב֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא כְּלֵ֖ב אִשָּׁ֥ה מְצֵרָֽה׃

controles.web: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized, and the heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
controles.kjv: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men’s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
controles.livre: Tomadas são as cidades, e invadidas são as fortalezas; e o coração dos guerreiros de Moabe naquele dia será como o coração de mulher em dores de parto.

versos.hebraico: וְנִשְׁמַ֥ד מוֹאָ֖ב מֵעָ֑ם כִּ֥י עַל־יְהוָ֖ה הִגְדִּֽיל׃

controles.web: Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the Lord.
controles.livre: E Moabe será destruído de modo que deixará de ser povo, pois se engrandeceu contra o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: פַּ֥חַד וָפַ֖חַת וָפָ֑ח עָלֶ֛יךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב מוֹאָ֖ב נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are on you, inhabitant of Moab, says Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the Lord.
controles.livre: Medo, cova, e laço vem sobre ti, ó morador de Moabe,diz o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: הניס מִפְּנֵ֤י הַפַּ֨חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל־הַפַּ֔חַת וְהָֽעֹלֶה֙ מִן־הַפַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּפָּ֑ח כִּֽי־אָבִ֨יא אֵלֶ֧יהָ אֶל־מוֹאָ֛ב שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: He who flees from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation, says Yahweh.
controles.kjv: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith the Lord.
controles.livre: O que fugir do medo, cairá na cova; e o que subir da cova, ficará preso do laço; porque eu trarei sobre ele, sobre Moabe, o ano de sua punição,diz o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: בְּצֵ֥ל חֶשְׁבּ֛וֹן עָמְד֖וּ מִכֹּ֣חַ נָסִ֑ים כִּֽי־אֵ֞שׁ יָצָ֣א מֵחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן וְלֶֽהָבָה֙ מִבֵּ֣ין סִיח֔וֹן וַתֹּ֨אכַל֙ פְּאַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב וְקָדְקֹ֖ד בְּנֵ֥י שָׁאֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire is gone out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and has devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
controles.kjv: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
controles.livre: Os que fugiam da força, paravam à sombra de Hesbom; porém fogo saiu de Hesbom, e labareda do meio de Seom, e queimou a testa de Moabe, e o topo da cabeça dos filhos do tumulto.

versos.hebraico: אוֹי־לְךָ֣ מוֹאָ֔ב אָבַ֖ד עַם־כְּמ֑וֹשׁ כִּֽי־לֻקְּח֤וּ בָנֶ֨יךָ֙ בַּשֶּׁ֔בִי וּבְנֹתֶ֖יךָ בַּשִּׁבְיָֽה׃

controles.web: Woe to you, O Moab! the people of Chemosh is undone; for your sons are taken away captive, and your daughters into captivity.
controles.kjv: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.
controles.livre: Ai de ti, Moabe! Pereceu o povo de Quemos; pois teus filhos foram levados cativos, e tuas filhas foram em cativeiro.

versos.hebraico: וְשַׁבְתִּ֧י שְׁבוּת־מוֹאָ֛ב בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה עַד־הֵ֖נָּה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט מוֹאָֽב׃ס

controles.web: Yet will I bring back the captivity of Moab in the latter days, says Yahweh. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
controles.kjv: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the Lord. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
controles.livre: Porém restaurarei Moabe de seu infortúnio nos últimos dias, diz o SENHOR. Até aqui é o julgamento de Moabe.
